grammar.summary: 本课以打捞沉船为线索，集中运用了被动语态、定语从句与过去完成时，并出现 must have been 表示对过去的推测。重点体会叙事中如何用被动语态突出「被打捞的物品」、用定语从句补充说明沉船细节、用过去完成时交代先于打捞发生的事件。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 当要突出动作的承受者、或不必指出动作执行者时用被动语态：be + 过去分词。本课大量使用被动叙述「电报被收到、物品被打捞、被送往」的过程，主语多为物品本身，使叙述更客观。

examples.en: A radio message from the mainland had been received by the ship's captain instructing him to give up the search.
examples.cn: 返航前，该船船长收到了大陆发来的电报，指示他们放弃这次搜寻。

examples.en: All the items that were found were sent to the War Museum.
examples.cn: 那次打捞到的所有物品均被送往军事博物馆。

examples.en: The Karen had been sailing in a convoy to Russia when she was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.
examples.cn: “卡伦”号当年在为其他船只护航驶往俄国的途中突然遭到敌方潜水艇鱼雷的袭击。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 which/that 引导定语从句，修饰先行词并补充信息，which 指物。本课用 which 修饰信件、船名，用 that 修饰信息，使长句紧凑。

examples.en: The small ship, Elkor, which had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks, was on its way home.
examples.cn: 小船“埃尔科”号在巴伦支海搜寻了几个星期之后，正在返航途中。

examples.en: There were books, clothing and photographs, together with letters which the seaman had once received from his wife.
examples.cn: 其中有书箱、衣服、照片以及水手收到的妻子的来信。

examples.en: From this the captain was able to piece together all the information that had come to light.
examples.cn: 据此，船长可以将所有的那些已经搞清的材料拼凑起来。

points.title: 过去完成时与 must have been 推测 (Past Perfect & Past Deduction)
points.explanation: 过去完成时 (had + 过去分词) 表示「先于过去某动作发生」的动作。本课中「被击沉」「丢失」先于「打捞」「拼凑」等过去动作，故用 had been sunk / had been sailing。must have been + 名词/过去分词 表示对过去事实的肯定推测。

examples.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
examples.cn: 事实上，他们发现的是另一艘沉没多年的船。

examples.en: From a heavy gun that was raised, the captain realized that the ship must have been a cruiser.
examples.cn: 从捞起的一门大炮来看，船长认为那艘船一定是艘巡洋舰。

exercises.q: The small ship, Elkor, ______ had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks, was on its way home.
A radio message from the mainland had been ______ by the ship's captain instructing him to give up the search.
From a heavy gun that was raised, the captain realized that the ship ______ a cruiser.
下列哪个词与课文中 salvage 的含义最接近？
用被动语态填空：All the items that were found ______ (send) to the War Museum.（写出 send 的正确形式）
